name: new_sudoku_benchmark_2045_with_variants_extra_only
description: A dataset of 2,045 Sudoku puzzles including variant puzzle types designed to evaluate a model's ability to solve Sudoku-style logic puzzles. Problems are provided in compact textual/grid form and the benchmark measures generation of the correct completed grid. It focuses on logical/reasoning capability rather than natural-language understanding.
reputation: A specialized puzzle-solving benchmark with limited community adoption, primarily used for evaluating reasoning and stepwise problem-solving capability.
